purpose: More than double effective ATLAS workflow speed where representative evidence supports it while lowering avoidable compute, token, cost, retry, and coordination churn and converting verified historical repetition into governed Engineering Memory without weakening correctness, verification, safety, or authority boundaries.
scope: all ATLAS-governed task and workflow prompts
phase-specific model, reasoning, verbosity, and service-tier routing
prompt, context, tool-surface, history-read, and commentary overhead
task clustering, retry suppression, cursor and receipt reuse
bounded host compute and storage cleanup
cursor-driven review of every retrievable authorized Codex, ChatGPT, and Claude task corpus and deduplicated pattern learning
content-addressed inventory and learning across every retrievable durable software receipt or receipt-like lifecycle artifact in scope
repetition-to-automation candidate discovery through existing Engineering Memory gates
measurement and continuous improvement of atlas-thread-capability-retirement conversions from completed standing tasks into reusable skills or genuinely stateful agents
retrieval-on-demand and provenance-preserving synthesis across ATLAS, Windows, Codex, imported or exported Claude context, and direct operator evidence
non_authority: provider, Supabase, production, live-data, secret, billing, or destructive authority
removal of required verification, independent review, migration proof, or safety gates

unified_lineage.runner_contract: One recurring heartbeat targets only the canonical task, selects the highest-value non-conflicting component cluster, and persists one shared checkpoint and next wake condition.

atlas_first_execution.requirement: Use Atlas as the operating substrate for every optimization and learning cluster while incrementally improving the same canonical system.
pre_mutation: read the smallest current workflow manifest and shared task checkpoint slice
resolve the exact selector or admitted packet, binding, writer lease, and valid prior receipts
answer whether the problem was already solved through Engineering Memory and record reuse or explicit rejection
canonical_seams: Engineering Memory precedent search, mutation gate, EvidenceBundle, and KnowledgeCandidate
owner-first routing, correlations, exact resource claims, and wake conditions
atlas_first_execution.adoption_proof: Every Atlas setup or optimization ratchet must remove a measured bottleneck, enable real admitted work, or strengthen proof at an existing risk boundary, and must pass the touched contract plus one representative inheriting workflow.
prohibitions: meta-work with no measured workflow or proof effect

context_domains.boundary: No absorption of repository writers, Release, provider, production, Supabase, live-data, secret, billing, or destructive authority.
No ambient screen or history claim, secrets extraction, deletion, or retention change without proven exact targets and authority.

sources: supported terminal, browser, app, and task readbacks
context_domains.boundary: A title, goal, plugin, remembered fact, or broad filesystem access does not create protected or external effect authority.

sources: every task or chat retrievable through supported app readback
context_domains.boundary: ChatGPT private or cloud history is not ambiently available; unreadable or unexported tasks remain inventoried UNKNOWN, and conversation prose does not outrank current source or validated receipts.

sources: explicitly imported Claude Code or Claude Cowork setup
context_domains.boundary: Claude cloud or private context is not ambiently available and is not current until imported, exported, connected, or read back through a supported authorized surface.

sources: other explicitly scoped durable lifecycle artifacts
context_domains.boundary: Receipt intake is read-only evidence. It grants no provider, production, live-data, secret, billing, destructive, merge, deployment, or owner-repository authority; secrets and raw tool outputs are excluded.
Never paste raw histories into the active task, merge conflicting authorities, or present inference as verified state.

default_work: canonical routing of reusable approved rules
context_domains.boundary: Silence is not approval and one task's authority does not generalize to protected effects or unrelated owners.

operating_cycle: discover the smallest required source slice
classify truth, currentness, provenance, and authority
measure the bottleneck and preserve UNKNOWN telemetry
choose one coherent precedent-aware ratchet with rollback
execute only admitted work in the exact writer and effect scope
verify the touched contract and a representative inherited workflow
deduplicate the learning and route retained candidates to exact owners
persist Done, Now, Next, receipts, blockers, source refs, and next cursor or wake condition

routing.escalation: Escalate immediately at a declared high-risk boundary or after two bounded cheaper-tier failures for the same reason; record why and downshift when the boundary closes.
routing.title_independence: A standing task title never establishes a permanent frontier-model or high-reasoning floor.

measurement.primary_outcome: verified useful work per wall-clock hour
measurement.target: >2x portfolio median effective speed versus the recorded representative baseline
measurement.unknown_rule: Unavailable telemetry is recorded as UNKNOWN in evidence or extensions and is never fabricated as zero.
measurement.claim_rule: Fewer turns, less text, a faster model, or a lower cost is not an optimization win unless the quality floor passes.

ratchet.method: Change one variable class at a time where practical, compare representative clusters, preserve a rollback boundary, and adopt only proof-backed gains.

prohibitions_before_escalation: retry or owner polling solely to reproduce the observation

census_identity_classes.auxiliary_denominator: ephemeral reviewer and bounded helper identities
census_identity_classes.classification_requirement: Every newly observed Codex identity is classified before material-delta evaluation; self-generated ephemeral identities remain measurable but cannot trigger a material handoff solely because the program created them.

avoided_amplification_measurement.unit: unchanged single-observation plus ephemeral-only census cycle
basis: After canonical FA-026, Master Plan R027 and successor 106 added one downstream worker wake and two receipt or adoption artifacts without admitting implementation.
An ephemeral-only Census delta would otherwise add at least one material integrator handoff and one adoption receipt while changing no standing or user-visible task coverage.
avoided_amplification_measurement.claim_boundary: This is a conservative avoided-amplification lower bound for the evidenced paths, not a universal speed or cost claim.

common_release_safety_controls.publication_claim_boundary: INSTALLED describes the source-proven local ATLAS control. Current-main installation is not claimed until this publication-held candidate is separately published and merged.

pc024.rule: Canonicalize strict same-origin Workbox URL keys before exact comparison; relative and root-relative paths may converge, but origin, decoded-path safety, admitted query and fragment semantics, duplicate detection, required coverage, byte count, and SHA-256 identity remain exact.
pc024.owner_boundary: The common validator is root-owned; product verifier integration remains owner-repository work.

pc025.rule: Before a linkage-capable Vercel CLI surface, validate an immutable workspace, project, organization or team, binding-file hash, non-reparse binding path, and an explicitly classified command target without invoking Vercel.
pc025.owner_boundary: Provider commands, provider cleanup, .vercel mutation, deployment, and product integration remain separately owned and admitted.

canonical_contracts.extension_rule: Extend the canonical v2 seam additively; do not create another scheduler, task protocol, receipt protocol, supervisor task, or polling loop.

historical_learning.batch_preparation_contract: Select only unique logical turns immediately preceding the exact partial cursor, coalesce adjacent repeated turn-context segments, fail closed on non-contiguous duplicate turn identities, persist metadata and digests but no message text, exclude completed content and tool output, and leave cursor advancement to a validated review receipt.
historical_learning.review_finalization_contract: Revalidate the exact prepared plan against the source, fail closed on checkpoint or cursor drift, deduplicate against the current candidate ledger, and atomically persist the paraphrased batch, ledger, checkpoint, alignment, and canonical execution receipt without raw message content.

review_priority.source_order: Select the most recently updated authorized source with unread content, then work backward to older sources.
review_priority.page_order: Within a source, process the newest unread contiguous page at the exact durable cursor, then advance backward.
exceptions: older dependency required for current interpretation
authority, privacy, security, migration, or rollback boundary
current contradiction that explicitly requires older evidence
review_priority.supersession_rule: Newer validated truth may supersede older evidence; older evidence remains lineage and never overrides current source or receipts without explicit reconciliation.

rules: inventory every retrievable authorized Codex, ChatGPT, and Claude task plus every durable software receipt source in scope, and record inaccessible sources with exact wake conditions
never copy raw historical conversations into the active task
persist receipt identities, schemas, correlations, hashes, and secret-free paraphrases only; never persist raw tool output or secret material
never reread completed pages when content-addressed evidence is valid
route retained candidates to exact owners and require a newly admitted packet before source work
report unavailable content and telemetry as UNKNOWN
